summary: Iteration 5 full pass. Backend smoke pytest test_api_core.py = 15/15 PASSED. Frontend 100% pass on 390x844 fresh guest: (1) Streak nudge card renders below 'Salat hari ini' after Magrib with title 'Lengkapi hari ini, mulai streak' (streak=0), message 'Masih ada 5 salat belum dicatat…', and all 5 chips (streak-nudge-checkin-{subuh,zuhur,asar,magrib,isya}). Tapping streak-nudge-checkin-subuh opens 'Satu langkah baik' success sheet; closing with modal-close-button removes the chip, decrements message to '4 salat belum dicatat', and today-prayer-count updates 0→'1 dari 5 selesai'. (2) streak-nudge-dismiss-button hides the card immediately, and after full page reload (same guest, localStorage preserved) the card remains hidden — persistence key streak-nudge:<user_id>:<day> works. (3) After checking all 5 prayers via nudge chips (last one triggers level-up overlay directly instead of success sheet, as documented in iteration_4), the nudge is absent from the DOM once returned to Home. (4) Badge share Entry A: level-up appears with levelup-title='Level Awan'; levelup-share-button opens 'Bagikan lencana' sheet with share-badge-box, share-badge-title='Level Awan', 'LENCANA AWAN' badge, '1 hari · berturut-turut' pill; share-stats-switch is correctly NOT rendered while share-name-switch IS rendered. modal-close-button + levelup-continue-button both work. (5) Entry B (Progress tab → achievement slides): achievement-awan slide has achievement-share-awan gold button; achievement-share-{bintang,purnama,syams} are absent for locked slides. Tapping opens badge sheet with 9:16 template. (6) Entry C (Progress → progress-achievements-button → Achievements screen): achievement-row-share-awan visible on unlocked row and opens badge sheet; achievement-row-share-{bintang,purnama,syams} absent on locked rows. (7) 9:16 verified via bounding box: share-template width=346, height=615, ratio=1.777 (target 1.778, off by 0.001) in share-badge, share-progress, and Entry-B/Entry-C share-badge modes. Hint text mentions '9:16'. Content fits, sheet scrolls to Latar/Nuansa/Caption/switch/share-confirm-button. (8) Regression in badge mode: share-template-haji, share-style-2, share-caption-2 all toggled successfully; share-confirm-button clicked on web without crash (toast fallback path). (9) Console: 0 React errors across all runs. No RN red screen. share-verse (daily-share-button) already verified in iteration_4 and uses identical cardWidth/cardHeight formula (ShareComposer.tsx:31), so 9:16 applies uniformly across all four modes (share-verse, share-progress, success, share-badge).

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing benign RN-web deprecation warnings unchanged from iter2-iter4. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: StreakNudge.tsx gates render with 4 correct conditions: !magrib, timeNow<magrib.time, missing.length===0, dismissed!==false — so it only appears after Magrib, hides once all 5 checked, and stays dismissed for the day via storage key streak-nudge:<user_id>:<day>.
ShareComposer.tsx:31 uses a single formula cardHeight = round(cardWidth*16/9) so 9:16 is enforced identically across share-verse/share-progress/success/share-badge — no per-mode drift.
Badge mode correctly hides share-stats-switch via `{!isBadge && <switchItem>…</switchItem>}` (line 70) while keeping share-name-switch — matches spec.
Progress.tsx conditionally renders per-slide share button only when item.unlocked (line 29) and per-row share Tap only when level.unlocked (line 73) — locked badges cannot be shared, verified live.

LevelUp.tsx:62 wires levelup-share-button → setModal({type:'share-badge', level:…}), reusing GlobalOverlay's ShareComposer dispatch (GlobalOverlay.tsx:47 includes 'share-badge' in modal.type whitelist) — single source of truth for badge sheets.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral guest sessions via POST /api/auth/guest; today's 5 prayer check-ins recorded per guest to unlock Awan and trigger level-up. No shared/seeded data touched.
